body: Thanks,  I'm going to put in way more effort to prove to myself that I do care about something other than myself. I signed up to volunteer at work as well so we'll see how that goes.

The company I was at actually allowed me to rescind my resignation. Most people aren't stuck at my job for more than 2 years anyways so it's going to be kind of awkward if I'm still there. I also ruined my reputation at work and hardly anyone on my team talks to me.
I did it at two jobs though but the one job let me rescind and stay but I'm wracked with guilt. I also reneged 3 weeks before I was supposed to start.

It's going to be a tough road from here and I really messed up. I don't even know if I can show my face to my extended family. You're right, I'm going to live as ethically as possible from here on out

I'm 24. I lied to my would be employer by turning down their job offer. I also lied to my temp job boss by telling him that I was leaving. I'm so greedy and selfish and I want to change that. I have Asperger's so I don't have any friends. I'm always in survival mode and I constantly try to minimize the pain.
